info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Rates-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Rates API provides users with access to current mortgage loan rates, facilitating informed financial decisions. By leveraging this API, consumers can retrieve detailed rate information for various loan options, making it valuable for borrowers, lenders, and financial advisors alike. Typical use cases include comparing rates to choose suitable mortgage products or integrating with financial applications for real-time data. The API ensures that users have up-to-date information to guide their mortgage-related activities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the latest interest rates for various loan types, enabling users to make informed borrowing decisions.
